title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 flagship model
summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.5, a frontier model focused on agentic workflows, coding, research and document creation. It reportedly uses about a quarter of the tokens of GPT-5.4 high and a third of those of Opus 4.7, scores 82.7% on terminal-bench and 58.6% on SWE-bench Verified, and is priced at $5 per 1M input tokens and $30 per 1M output tokens.

research.description: GPT-5.5 launched 2026-04-23 (API on 2026-04-24); rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and via Codex. GPT-5.5 Instant became the default for free users on 2026-05-05.
